jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. Together, we strive to inspire our employees and customers through innovative technology, modern structures, and sustainable growthTogether Towards the Future. Are You Ready to Join Us?If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Ms. Jasmin Hohmann at +49 561 50019-201.Convince Us. We Look Forward to Getting to Know You!Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Anlagenbau, Fertigungstechnik, Projektmanagement, Schweißtechnik

jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. You will lead a research topic of your own and help drive improvements across the platform.You will join a team with strong views and deep experience, where open debate is part of the daily routine. We are looking for a market-savvy, self-starting colleague who can hold and defend a view when challenged, stays open to being challenged in return, and combines a clear team-player mindset with the initiative to run with the ball.What you will do- Take on day-to-day portfolio management responsibility for the main franchise following a short onboarding, with the aim of becoming deputy portfolio manager of the flagship offering.- Develop a thorough understanding of how the product works and present it with clarity and conviction to clients and distribution partners.- Generate absolute and relative investment ideas for implementation in the portfolio, and contribute to marketing and idea-generation activities.- Bring well-founded investment convictions to the team, challenge team members constructively and welcome being challenged in return.- Lead a research topic across derivatives, cross-asset, fixed income or equities, and drive improvements across the platform.- Collaborate closely across teams as a clear team player, while taking ownership and working independently without the need for constant supervision.What you bring- Relevant experience as a portfolio manager, with evidence of investment judgement and the readiness to assume deputy responsibility for the flagship offering.- Strong quantitative background. Programming skills, in particular AI-enabled programming, are welcome but not essential.- Genuine passion for markets, with the confidence to form a clear view, defend it with evidence under challenge and stand firm within a team with strong views.- Strong understanding of financial markets, with a degree in finance or a related field, or a professional qualification such as the CFA. Derivatives expertise is considered an advantage.- Technical versatility and an interest in applying data and technology to investment decisions.- Strong command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with Bloomberg is required.- Fluent English is required. German is an advantage; proficiency in another European language is an advantage.- Academic excellence combined with a true team-player attitude and a self-starting, proactive way of working.- Experience with Data Analytics.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- … and so much more!
